faq: Which platforms can you write for?
Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X, Pinterest and TikTok captions are the usual choices. Tell us your platforms and we adapt length and style for each, since one caption rarely suits all of them.
Will you post for me without asking?
No. Posts are drafted and loaded as scheduled drafts or sent to you for approval. If you want us to schedule them, you add us as a collaborator, never by sharing a password.
Can you use my product photos?
Yes. Send photos you own or have rights to, and we pair them with captions. We do not use stock images that you have no license for, and we do not fake customer photos.
Do you buy followers or likes?
Never. That breaks platform rules and does your account harm. We focus on useful posts, clear offers and timing, so your audience grows from real people.
